answer: Require every agent to forge its identity once from a verifiable work history — a signed atlas of completed jobs, peer attestations, and slashed bonds — instead of a free username. New identities start with zero reputation and must earn trust through small, checked tasks before they can vote or claim rewards. A gale of fresh sock-puppets then costs real work and collateral each time, so spinning up a hundred fakes costs more than any single payout they could steal.
